steps.observation:
show_account - Show your account information. Unlike show_profile, this includes private information.
signup - Sign up to create account.
delete_account - Delete your account.
update_account_name - Update your first or last name in the account profile.
login - Login to your account.
logout - Logout from your account.
send_verification_code - Send account verification code to your email address.
verify_account - Verify your account using the verification code sent to your email address.
send_password_reset_code - Send password reset code to your email address.
reset_password - Reset your password using the password reset code sent to your email address.
show_profile - Show public profile information of a user, including your friendship status with them.
search_users - Search Venmo users by name or email address.
search_friends - Search your or others' friends by name or email address.
add_friend - Add a friend to your friend list.
remove_friend - Remove a friend from your friend list.
show_venmo_balance - Show your Venmo balance.
add_to_venmo_balance - Add money to your Venmo balance.
withdraw_from_venmo_balance - Withdraw money from your Venmo balance.
show_bank_transfer_history - Show histroy of money transfer from Venmo to payment card and vice versa.
download_bank_transfer_receipt - Download the receipt of money transfer from Venmo to payment card or vice versa.
show_transaction - Show transaction details.
update_transaction - Update transaction information.
show_transactions - Get a list of your transactions.
create_transaction - Send money to a user.
download_transaction_receipt - Download the receipt of a transaction (money sent from one user to another).
like_transaction - Like a transaction.
unlike_transaction - Unlike a transaction.
show_transaction_comments - Get a list of transaction comments.
create_transaction_comment - Create a new transaction comment.
show_transaction_comment - Show detailed information about a transaction comment.
delete_transaction_comment - Delete a transaction comment.
update_transaction_comment - Update a transaction comment.
like_transaction_comment - Like a transaction comment.
unlike_transaction_comment - Unlike a previously liked transaction comment.
show_payment_card - Get details of a payment card.
delete_payment_card - Delete payment card information.
update_payment_card - Update payment card information.
show_payment_cards - Get a list of users payment cards.
add_payment_card - Add a new payment card.
show_received_payment_requests - Get a list of payment requests you have received from others.
show_sent_payment_requests - Get a list of payment requests you have sent to others.
create_payment_request - Send a payment request.
delete_payment_request - Delete a payment request.
update_payment_request - Update payment request information.
approve_payment_request - Approve a payment request.
deny_payment_request - Deny a payment request.
remind_payment_request - Send a reminder to a user via notification about this payment request.
show_social_feed - Show your social feed (transactions of your friends).
show_notifications - Get a list of your notifications.
delete_notifications - Delete all of your notifications.
mark_notifications - Mark all notifications as read or unread.
show_notifications_count - Get the count of your notifications.
delete_notification - Delete a notification.
mark_notification - Mark a notification as read or unread.

- **Add the Wells Fargo card to Venmo via `add_payment_card`**: The full Venmo API list reveals the Venmo app has an `add_payment_card` API ("Add a new payment card") — this is the likely path to fund the transaction, since the Wells Fargo card (2597882524365103, expires 2023-09, cvv 620) is valid and not yet linked to Venmo. **This succeeded** — the card was added as payment_card_id 478.
